name: Hardin County, KY
findings: Hardin County has 292 nonprofit organizations. 105 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 89 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Hardin County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Hardin County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Hardin County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 96 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list public events
observations.text: No hobby and sports organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 27 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
